games.name: Decaying Winter
games.desc:
Stranded on EDEN-227, a hostile planet where the day brings with it a lethal storm. Survive against hostile scavengers, militarized raiders, and seemingly supernatural enemies in this wave-based roguelike co-op survival. Can you survive until your evacuation?

This game can be used with a controller, but a keyboard and mouse is recommended.

Press J while in-game to open the votekick menu.

Griefing your teammates in public servers may result in a temporary ban.
Exploiting will result in a permanent ban.

games.name: Zombie Survival Garry's Mod [Old]
games.desc:
⚠️ THERE MAY BE BUGS! 

⚠️ This game is no longer being updated. Wait for a remake. ⚠️

Facepunch Studios & Valve: Assets.
JetBoom: Original Gamemode Inspiration.

💻 Controls:
M - Menu.
B - Shop
E - Interact.
F - Flashlight.
T - Chat.
CTRL - Crouch.

Do You have what it takes to survive all 6 waves?

Zombie Survival Garry's Mod is a game where a group of Survivors are present in an apocalyptic world with a threat of an incoming zombie horde hungry for their brains. Humans must prepare and work together and fight-off the zombies in order to prevail.

Work together with other survivors, create barricades using Carpenter's Hammer, cooperate, defeat Mini-Bosses, heal eachother using Medkits, and purchase arsenal of powerful weapons to gain an upperhand in-game.

🏷️ Tags: Garry's Mod, Zombie Survival, GMod, Half-Life, Valve, Hyper Realistic Guns, FPS.

📅 Join the group for update notifications! https://www.roblox.com/communities/35632691/Babus-Studios#!/about 📅
